name: Robotic Uprighting Unit
summary: Automatically converts products from horizontal to vertical orientation. Uses CCD vision to determine product position, and robots automatically pick and place to complete the vertical action.
contentHtml:
The robotic verticalization unit is an automated equipment developed by TXAM for product posture conversion.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a CCD vision system to automatically determine product position, guiding a six-axis robot to pick up the product and complete the posture conversion from horizontal to vertical. The verticalization process is smooth, effectively protecting product safety.

Technical Advantages

  • CCD vision guidance for accurate positioning
  • Smooth verticalization process to avoid product damage
  • Significantly reduces labor and improves efficiency
  • Customizable according to different product characteristics
